user.title: Groningen container fill level
user.description: Enter any address in the municipality of Groningen. It only unlocks the portal — it does not filter anything, so it need not be your own.

data_description.huisnummer: Digits only, no letters or additions

containers.title: Choose containers
containers.description: {count} containers with a fill sensor were found, nearest to home first. Pick the ones you want to follow.

data_description.containers: One sensor is created per container
data_description.scan_interval_hours: Hours between polls. The portal rebuilds a large payload each time, so hourly is the friendly minimum.

error.invalid_postcode: That does not look like a Dutch postcode (1234AB).
error.invalid_huisnummer: The house number must be digits only.
error.address_rejected: The portal says this address is outside the municipality.
error.protocol_changed: The portal has changed and the integration can no longer read it. See the repair notice.

abort.already_configured: This address is already set up.
abort.no_containers: No containers with a fill sensor were found for this address.

stale_operation_ids.title: Groningen portal has been redeployed
stale_operation_ids.description: The portal's internal operation identifiers changed, so fill levels can no longer be read. This needs a new version of the integration. Check HACS for an update, and if there is none, please open an issue on the project page.
